sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits older blocks and new turf alike
paras: The older suburbs have larger blocks and established gardens, and a big kikuyu or couch lawn that misses a few cuts takes several visits to bring back. A fortnightly cut keeps the grass at a steady height, shades out bindi and broadleaf weeds, and holds moisture over summer.

Coombs, Denman Prospect and Wright are a different job. These Molonglo Valley suburbs went in from the 2010s onward, with smaller blocks and newly laid turf that needs careful establishment mowing, cut high and only once it has rooted. Regular lawn mowing Weston Creek wide means we know which block is which.

sections.h2: Weston Creek seasons and lawn conditions
paras: The district sits below Mount Stromlo and Cooleman Ridge, and cold air settles across Duffy, Holder and Stirling in winter. Hard frosts from May to August stop most lawns growing, so we drop to a monthly tidy. From September the spring surge arrives and we move to fortnightly.

Autumn brings leaf drop from the deciduous street trees in the older suburbs, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings. Through the hot, dry summer our lawn mowing Weston Creek visits cut higher and less often so the lawn holds moisture, with water restrictions in mind.

faqs.q: Which Weston Creek suburbs do you cover?
faqs.a: All of them. Our lawn mowing Weston Creek service covers Fisher, Waramanga, Chapman, Weston, Rivett, Stirling, Holder and Duffy, plus Coombs, Denman Prospect and Wright. Weston Creek is our priority area, for one-off and regular scheduled visits.

faqs.q: How much does mowing cost in Weston Creek?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the block, the state of the lawn and what else is included, so we quote each lawn mowing Weston Creek job individually. Quotes are free and upfront, and we will not guess a price without seeing the block.

faqs.q: Can you mow newly laid turf in Coombs or Denman Prospect?
faqs.a: Yes. New turf needs establishment mowing: waiting until it has rooted, cutting high and removing only a little each time. We check the lawn before the first cut and bring it down gradually as it settles.

faqs.q: Do you take the clippings and green waste away in Weston Creek?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste removal is available with every mowing visit, and with garden maintenance and clean-ups too. If you would rather keep some clippings for compost or mulch, tell us and we will leave what you want.
